title: Supply contract A3279 - BevPack S.p.A.
content: Supply contract for capping machine model A3279, 8 stations. Payment: 30% on order, 40% on shipment, 30% on acceptance testing. Warranty: 24 months on mechanical parts, 12 months on electronic components. Delivery terms: FCA Canelli (AT).

title: Technical configuration sheet - A3279
content: Ordered configuration: 8 capping stations, max speed 450 caps/minute, 400V three-phase power supply, compatible cap sizes 28-38mm, standard spare parts kit included (12 months).

title: Delivery note - ORD-2026-001
content: Delivery completed on 2026-04-10 at the BevPack S.p.A. plant. Acceptance test passed on site, no anomalies found. Received by: R. Moretti, production manager.

title: Invoice - ORD-2026-002
content: Invoice for standard spare parts kit renewal, amount 4200.00 EUR, payment due 30 days from invoice date.

title: Invoice - ORD-2026-003
content: Invoice for 2 replacement optical sensors, amount 1850.00 EUR, payment due 30 days from invoice date.
